purpose: Roadmap for evidence-first Windows diagnostics and least-destructive recovery in Step & Flow.
principles: FSM controls routing; AI interprets but does not authorize transitions.
Prefer structured Windows evidence over guesses from user wording.
Use Microsoft and Windows-native diagnostics before third-party tools when sufficient.
Escalate collection progressively and only when the previous level is insufficient.
Recovery always proceeds from least destructive to most destructive.
Preview/experimental Windows features must never be presented as universally available.

evidence_collectors.rule: Use only the module relevant to the active case; PowerToys is not a generic repair step.
Consume structured read-only trace evidence; AI conclusions remain hypotheses until supported by trace evidence.
Use for evidence-backed interactive trace analysis, never as autonomous destructive repair authority.
Expert last; faulting module alone is not proof of root cause.

known_issue_resolver.guard: Never claim a known-issue match from symptom similarity alone; require compatible build/update/hardware evidence.

examples: supported point-in-time recovery capabilities when available
Reset this PC with keep-files option when appropriate
Cloud Rebuild only on supported Windows builds/devices
recovery_ladder.rule: Never present preview/unsupported Cloud Rebuild as a normal universal recovery option.

future_local_ai.role: Optional local classification and explanation layer.
allowed: classify user response into state-approved enum
explain a verified finding in beginner language
